desc:
Fish deeper and catch the FATTEST fish.
Can you collect all 77 fish?

How To Play:
🎣 Cast your hook deep into the sea.
🐟 Catch fish on the way up.
🦈 Sell fish or add them to your aquarium.
🦀🦈🐠🐡 Choose fish from your aquarium as pets that follow you and collect money.

Tips:
🦈 More rare, fatter fish are deeper.
👆 Hold to reel up faster and aim for fish swimming side-to-side.
🎣 Upgrade your fishing pole to cast your hook deeper.
⛵Upgrade your boat to hold more fish and move faster.
🎁 Hook chests to get the rarest fish inside.
💰💰💰💰 Customers pay more for rarer fish in your aquarium.

-----------------------------
🎣  HAPPY FISHING 🎣
